items.q: Which statement is true according to the passage?

choices.A: LNG is warmer than ordinary natural gas.
choices.B: Japan exports large amounts of LNG.
choices.C: Liquefaction projects are usually completed quickly.
choices.D: Ships can carry LNG to countries without pipeline connections.
choices.E: LNG takes up 600 times more space than gas.

passage_G: Liquefied natural gas (LNG) is natural gas that has been cooled to about minus 162 degrees Celsius. At this temperature, the gas becomes a liquid and takes up only about 1/600 of its original volume. This makes it possible to transport large amounts of gas by ship to countries that are far from gas fields and cannot be connected to them by pipelines. Japan, which has few domestic energy resources, is one of the largest importers of LNG in the world. However, building liquefaction plants requires huge investment, so such projects usually take many years to complete.
